header.title: School Radio
header.subtitle: Upload audio and schedule playback to the building's speakers.
header.scheduledPlaybacksTooltip: Upcoming and past playbacks in one window

netradio.description: Scroll through the list, pick the station and — if available — a substream, then press ▶. You can change the target and stream URLs below, or with the Edit button.
netradio.emptyList: The radio list is empty – use the "Restore defaults" button.
netradio.previewTooltip: Local listen-in (only for you, not on the school speakers)
netradio.exportTooltip: Saves the current list to a .json file
netradio.setDefaultTooltip: Every new user of this institution will see this list first
netradio.restoreTooltip: The list resets to the initial 16 stations (custom entries are lost)
netradio.footerHint: It's worth checking substream URLs on myonlineradio.hu. The list is stored in the browser (per institution and device)
netradio.footerHintAdminSuffix: – use the ⭐ button to make it the default for the whole institution.
netradio.scheduleEndHint: Playback stops at the time you set.
netradio.scheduleNoEndHint: Without an end time the broadcast runs until stopped manually.
netradio.selectHint: Select a station from the list

library.uploadPrompt: Drag a file here or click to upload

playTooltip.playing: Now playing – press again to restart
playTooltip.idle: Play now (on the currently selected target)

youtube.description: Search for a YouTube video, or paste a link. In the embedded player you can watch/scrub it locally, silently to everyone else — the "Send live" button is what actually starts it on the school speakers.
youtube.startPositionHint: E.g. 1:30 or 1:05:20 – the video starts here. Leave empty to start from the beginning.
youtube.useCurrentPositionTooltip: Insert the position the preview is paused at
youtube.historyEmpty: No videos watched yet – search for one
youtube.noVideoSelected: Pick a video from the list on the right
youtube.followHint: Radio playback follows the video's timeline: if you seek, the speakers jump there too.
youtube.scheduleFromHere: The scheduled playback starts where the video is now.

live.description: Digitises the audio input of this computer (microphone, line-in, USB sound card) and broadcasts it to the targeted players. For live talk, or for playing an analogue source – turntable, cassette, mixing desk – without digitising it first.
live.labelsAfterPermission: Device names appear after the first start (microphone permission).
live.inputGainHint: Turn a quiet source up, a distorting one down. Red on the meter already means distortion – turn it down there. Adjustable while on air.
live.outputVolumeHint: The volume heard on the players. The same slider as in the header.
live.latencyHint: The chain adds a few seconds of delay (capture, network, player buffer). Fine for one-way broadcast, not for two-way conversation.
live.unsupported: This browser does not support live audio capture.
live.permissionDenied: The browser was not granted permission to use the audio input.
live.snapOffline: The audio server is unreachable – cannot go on air.
live.replaced: Another live input took over the broadcast.
live.disconnected: Connection to the server was lost.
live.connectFailed: Could not connect to the server.
live.connectTimeout: The server did not respond in time.
live.eqHint: Lift the treble for a dull tape or record; pull the mid down for a boxy sound. After a strong boost watch the level meter – if it goes red, reduce the input gain.
live.meterHint: The meter runs even off air so you can set the level in advance. A good setting: peaks between -12 and -6 dB, with only the loudest parts touching red.
live.recordDiscardConfirm: Discard the recording? This cannot be undone.
live.recordHint: The recording captures the audio after input gain and tone control – exactly what goes on air. A recording saved to the library appears on the Audio library tab.

schedule.immediateTooltip: The file plays right away, no date/time needed
schedule.endTimeHint: If the sound is longer, it is faded out and stopped here. No effect on shorter sounds.

playlist.title: Playlist builder
playlist.emptyHint: Add tracks from the other tabs
playlist.uploadToListButton: Upload a sound file to the list
playlist.youtubeUrlHint: Paste a YouTube video link. Title and duration load automatically.
playlist.googleDriveHint: Paste a Google Drive file or folder link. Sound files are listed automatically.
playlist.recordingHint: Record a spoken segment and add it to the playlist. The recording is uploaded to the library and appended to the end of the list.
playlist.recordingStartHint: Click the button to start recording.
playlist.recordingDoneHint: Recording ready – give it a listen!

stationModal.needAtLeastOneStream: At least one stream is required
stationModal.myonlineradioHint: You can check public stream URLs and sub-channels on myonlineradio.hu.

history.rescheduleStreamHint: Internet radio schedule – reschedule it with the ⏰ button on the Internet radio tab
